answer:
Verdict: yes

## Process wait pattern

Across the whole trace (0–30,614 ms), the parser (TID 645805) ended 51.6% of other threads’ waits by waking them, but the analysis classifies its hold-up as **minor**, not a bottleneck. The sinks were waiting for work from the parser, one at a time.

## Sink activity

Of the four sinks, **three stayed idle**: sink-1 (TID 645802), sink-2 (TID 645803), and sink-3 (TID 645804). Each was blocked for about 30,000 ms and never woke to do work during the window. Sink-0 (TID 645801) did most of the sink work, running for 81.0% of its time.
